Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly inferred that Greenfield, Indiana is the county seat of Hamilton County and concluded “Hamilton County, Indiana” without verification. In reality, Greenfield is the county seat of Hancock County. This error stems from misidentifying the county and failing to cross-check the city–county mapping before declaring the task complete.
